## Summary

Describe the requested feature.

## Problem / Use Case

What validation problem would this solve?

## Proposed Behavior

Describe how the feature should work.

## Scope

- Windows host readiness
- Network / iSCSI
- MPIO
- Hyper-V
- Failover Cluster
- ActiveCluster topology
- Export / reporting
- User interface
- Other

## Read-Only Requirement

Explain how the feature remains read-only.

The validator must not make host, network, MPIO, cluster, disk, iSCSI-session, or FlashArray configuration changes.

## Environment-Specific Assumptions

List assumptions about:

- host roles
- site layout
- array topology
- IP addressing
- path counts
- preferred arrays
- naming conventions

Environment-specific assumptions should be configurable rather than hardcoded.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe other approaches considered.

## Additional Context

Add diagrams, screenshots, or examples if useful.
